top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori, Ye) are a mature, experimentally verified invention: the magic-wavelength lattice cancels the light shift so many neutral atoms can be interrogated Doppler- and recoil-free, and independent laboratories now agree near 1e-18. The two-name allocation is clean with no arbitrary cut, the citation scope is distinct from the earlier comb and trapped-ion prizes, and no award would not be justified when a ripe, uncontested achievement is on the table.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only a general field proximity as a Lund atomic physicist, with no documented tie to Katori or Ye
